title: Who the Sea Peoples were
summary: Egyptian records name groups who raided and invaded around 1200 BCE, but the origins of several, such as the Weshesh, are unknown. Many seem to have travelled by land.
why: They are bound up with the collapse of the Bronze Age world.
question: Who were the Sea Peoples who attacked Egypt, and where did they come from?
evidence: Recorded by Ramesses II, Merneptah (c. 1200 BCE) and Ramesses III at Medinet Habu (Year 8, c. 1175 BCE); 'Sea Peoples' is a modern label.
wouldSettle: Archaeological and genetic links between destruction layers, new settlers and named groups' homelands.
